traceability.notes:
The story 003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS defines core ESLint rules `require-story-annotation` and `require-req-annotation` that must enforce @story and @req annotations consistently across the same set of function-like constructs, support JavaScript and TypeScript, provide configurable scope and export-priority behavior, deliver clear error messages, and handle malformed/edge-case inputs gracefully.
The implementation provides both rules with aligned detection scope (FunctionDeclaration, FunctionExpression, MethodDefinition, TSDeclareFunction, TSMethodSignature) and shared configuration semantics (DEFAULT_SCOPE, EXPORT_PRIORITY_VALUES, shouldProcessNode). Arrow functions are explicitly excluded from required coverage by default and are treated accordingly in both code and tests. JSDoc and comment parsing, along with line, parent-chain, and fallback-text heuristics, are implemented in reusable helpers and mirrored between story and requirement rules, with extensive tests confirming correct behavior and resilient error handling.
Dedicated rule documentation exists for both rules, including examples and configuration details. Numerous test suites explicitly tied to this story validate function detection, TypeScript support, scope/exportPriority behavior, auto-fix behavior, and robustness against malformed inputs. All such tests pass under the project’s Jest test run.
Based on this concrete evidence, all acceptance criteria and specified requirements for this story are fully implemented and verified, so the story is assessed as PASSED.
